name: Composite Image Loss with Visibility Weighting
definition: The total loss function used for training, combining image reconstruction losses weighted by visibility, perceptual loss, and regularization terms for sampling coordinates and visibility map.
summary: Composite Image Loss with Visibility Weighting supervises radiance field training by weighting photometric terms with a visibility map to ignore occluded regions, distinguishing itself by integrating this masking strategy into the core loss definition.
